items.title: Dan Morgenstern interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 9, 2013
items.q: Like daytime TV, which I never watched before, it’s astonishing how many women there are on television as anchors, as reporters. Actually they outnumber the men. And they’re very good. ctx.x: I mean that was it. And that wasn’t fair. Once in a while there would be somebody maybe in the trumpet section. And in the late sixties, early seventies, when was it, there was this really good lead trumpet player women, I think she’s still around. She eventually got some studio work and stuff. And she was a great lead trumpet player. And then you had Diva. That’s where I first heard Anat actually. She was one of the best people in that band. But it was really a hell of a band.
